scope: Every overlapping 1-second window at 0.5-second stride containing at least 0.25 seconds of speech. Identical word masks in source and stem; limiter effects measured, not described as new source defects.

wholeWindowDiagnosticReview.interpretation: Original diagnostic compared speech-only source RMS against a whole stem window. With identical speech samples, the measured difference is within the limiter tolerance. This is a signal comparison, not an audition.
